search_window.basis: Prior hourly execution finished at approximately 18:49 PDT; late-arriving indexing is not proof of a new event.

coverage_notes.scope: Supplementary targeted recall only: sole/last/full-service grocery disruption, weather/disaster-canceled emergency food distribution, abrupt pantry/food-bank loss, and official immediate SNAP/WIC/food-assistance access interruption.
query_context: site:gov "SNAP" "October 10, 2026" interruption benefits outage office closed
coverage_notes.excluded: Scheduled holiday/weekend pantry closures; dated 2025 notices and unrelated older articles; non-U.S. grocery closures; normal food distributions and event calendars; unverified disruptions outside the hourly observation window.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search indexing returned predominantly historical or unrelated material. No newly verifiable qualifying incident discovered. Delayed local reporting or search indexing may hide events. Production nationwide collection remains authoritative.
coverage_notes.changes: No approval, publishing, collection, or schedule changes.
